summary.overview: The project has rich documentation (4 rules, 4 skills, 920 memories) and a clear decisional AGENTS.md, but skills are monoliths without progressive disclosure, no post-change verification (type-check, tests) is observed after edits, and 920 memories contain title collisions to deduplicate.

dimensions.label: Task Understanding
dimensions.summary: AGENTS.md provides rich decisional context (architecture, semantics, seeds, walkthroughs). The 4 rules cover backend, frontend conventions, and documentation management.

dimensions.label: Controlled Execution
dimensions.summary: Supported commands are visible in scripts/, but no Hooks are configured to automate verifications (post-edit type-check, lint, tests). Execution relies entirely on manual rule following.

dimensions.label: Change Validation
dimensions.summary: 0 out of 68 sessions show structured verification after changes (withChecks: 0). Sessions produce edits without type-check, tests, or lint validation. Manual API walkthroughs are positive but not reproducible.

dimensions.label: Reliable Delivery
dimensions.summary: Sessions produce observed changes but without structured acceptance evidence. Closure is mostly 'no-change-observed' or 'changed-without-check'. No systematic result verification.

dimensions.label: Learning Capture
dimensions.summary: 920 project memories cover all domain aspects. However, no outcome review has validated that retrieved memories actually improve results. 5 exact collisions and 12 similar pairs signal a governance need.

findings.title: All 4 project skills are monoliths without progressive disclosure
findings.reason: Each skill ranges from 1195 to 2220 lines with no reference files to decompose content. The agent-assets lint reports 4 warnings (skill-length-hard-cap) and 4 advisories (skill-long-without-progressive-references). Each invocation consumes the full context, reducing space for target code and evidence. The owner is the project team (skill author).
expectedOutput: Extract detail sections (conventions, patterns, examples) into Markdown files under references/ of each skill
SKILL.md keeps only the progressive index: summary, triggers, and links to references
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

All 4 project skills are monoliths (1195-2220 lines) without progressive disclosure.

## Evidence

- elisaschool-business-logic: 1860 lines, 0 references
- elisaschool-dev: 2083 lines, 0 references
- elisaschool-frontend-dev: 2220 lines, 0 references
- elisaschool-frontend-refactor: 1195 lines, 0 references

## Action

For each skill:
1. Identify detail sections (patterns, examples, conventions)
2. Extract them to <skill>/references/<section>.md
3. Replace in SKILL.md with a progressive link
4. Validate with asset-baseline lint

findings.title: No structured verification observed after code changes
findings.reason: Out of 68 analyzed sessions (7 days), withChecks = 0. Sessions produce file edits (E3: 2 edits, 1 file) without running type-check, lint, or tests afterwards. The friction count is high (E1: 16, E2: 27 execution failures) but no friction consequence is documented. The owner is the project team — verification scripts exist (tsc, eslint) but are not automated via Hooks.
expectedOutput: Configure a Qoder Hook that runs tsc --noEmit after each TypeScript file edit
Or add a systematic verification step in session workflows
findings.expectedArtifact: PostToolUse Hook or post-edit verification script
